label: Beurre d'Isigny
note: AOP (PDO since 1996) from the Bay of Veys, Normandy; can be salted, and can be textured to suit puff pastry; creamy and hazelnut aromas

about.text: Butter from the Bay of Veys in Normandy with a protected designation of origin (AOP, PDO since 1996). It can be salted, and can be textured to suit puff pastry; creamy, with hazelnut aromas.
